description: This file defines an abstract class `StreamHandshakeToken` and its derived sealed classes `StartToken` and `DeliveryToken`, used for stream handshake processes within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes methods for creating tokens, equality checks, and hash code generation.

classes.name: StreamHandshakeToken
classes.description: An abstract class representing a handshake token used in Orleans streams, with token creation and equality logic.

classes.name: StartToken
classes.description: A sealed class extending `StreamHandshakeToken`, representing a start token.

classes.name: DeliveryToken
classes.description: A sealed class extending `StreamHandshakeToken`, representing a delivery token.

methods.name: CreateStartToken
methods.description: Creates a `StartToken` instance from a `StreamSequenceToken`, or returns default if input is null.

methods.name: CreateDeliveyToken
methods.description: Creates a `DeliveryToken` instance from a `StreamSequenceToken`, or returns default if input is null.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this token and another `StreamHandshakeToken`.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides `Object.Equals` to compare this token to another object.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the token's type and `Token` property.
